summary.en: Three fields in one row. Alignment and logic are well held (dossiers A and L) and credited, with Bostrom, Löb, reward hacking and value lock-in unnamed; psychology is one clause on habit, the rest absent by name though 03 §12 holds laws of its form. Divergence kept: addiction continues with the loss read, gradual disempowerment is not a fall the account ranks, attachment and Gödel are not carried. No source found arguing against the account's form, so no contrary reading; I looked.

name.en: Habit as a value-free trace of past action

source.work: Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig (2019), Habits without values; Wood and Rünger (2016), Psychology of habit; Dickinson (1985)

sense.en: Repetition itself strengthens a response, apart from the value of its outcomes. A habit is cued by context and, once formed, is less sensitive to outcome devaluation. Miller and others model habit strength as a trace of past actions, arbitrating with goal-directed control, which can override it.

reading.en: The count law has the form: the choice raises the count that the next choice's rule reads, a score standing apart. Same mechanism for the value-free part, in two policies, whole-number counts and no noise. The account's lock has one controller, so 'never leaves' holds where the source has arbitration; the account also keeps the failed human replications. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts for the count laws). A chooser over two policies takes the first where its rule weighs it at least as much, that policy's count rising by one. Under a standing score, the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves. Not shown: that actual agents, brains or trained systems count so.

A rule read from the count of its choices is the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989) and, counting the action taken, the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019). What the law adds is exactness for a simplified model and its edges, so as a containment of the free-energy principle it is a restatement.

02 §9, Reading [AI reading, D45] two paragraphs after this passage: in rats, extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation (Adams 1982; Dickinson 1985); five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018). This passage: counts that only grow can survive noise, cited, not stated.

account_adds.en: The law's edges: a moved count, a stale rule or a change of score read late carries the course across; counted from the posterior, a score favouring the second policy lowers the first's share at every step; the locked course outlives every bound on an unread rising coordinate.

source_adds.en: The context cue, on which habit depends (a changed context disrupts it); arbitration with goal-directed control; graded strength that decays when the act stops; dissociable neural systems. None is stated: the law has no context, no second controller, no decay.

name.en: Addiction: compulsive seeking with the harm known

source.work: Robinson and Berridge (1993), incentive sensitization; Everitt and Robbins (2005); Redish (2004); Koob and Le Moal (2001); Heyman (2009), Addiction: A Disorder of Choice

sense.en: Rival accounts: wanting sensitized apart from liking; a drift from goal-directed to habitual control; a drug's signal that prediction cannot cancel; a shifted hedonic set point. All describe use continuing against known harm. Contested: many recover unaided (Robins on Vietnam veterans; Heyman), and how far use is compulsive is disputed. My knowledge here is secondary.

reading.en: Proposed here. Use raising what reads the next use has the counted lock's form, and a target of more than now cannot rest. But the lock's premise is a loss nothing reads, and the source's central case is the loss read and use continuing: that lies outside `Unread`, in what 03 lists as open. Redish's signal acts on the reading itself, nearer a corrupted channel. Unaided recovery sits badly beside a lock. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest). 'More than now' is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world. The text after it: a seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest never comes to rest with it met; where such seeking draws on what stands, its losses beyond its coupling closure do not return through its own feedback.

[AI reading over the proved cases.] Counts that accumulate instead of being drawn, which with noisy choices are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (cited, not stated); a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.
Open: cognition beyond composition, among it motivation and affect (salience, wanting what is misrepresented, recognizing a reason without acting).

account_adds.en: Which locks noise leaves; that a selection through couplings cannot reach a loss beyond them. Neither is said of addiction anywhere in the account.

source_adds.en: The dissociation of wanting from liking; use against a loss read; tolerance and withdrawal; relapse after long abstinence and cue reinstatement; natural recovery; dopamine's role. None is stated, and the first two are the core of the field.

name.en: Learned helplessness: no longer trying where trying would work

source.work: Seligman and Maier (1967); Abramson, Seligman and Teasdale (1978); Maier and Seligman (2016), Learned helplessness at fifty

sense.en: Animals given inescapable shock later fail to escape where escape is open; the first account was a learned expectation that acts do not matter, later attributional. In 2016 its authors reversed the mechanism: passivity is the unlearned default response to prolonged aversion, and what is learned is control, which inhibits that default through prefrontal circuitry.

reading.en: Proposed here. The 1967 behaviour has the witness's form: an act that would separate two worlds exists, the formation's own choice never takes it, and its model is never refuted. Here one experiment does separate, unlike what seeking cannot separate. The dispute over motivation or expectancy has the form of a model and a ranking acting alike. The 2016 mechanism does not fit: the witness has no default. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, with a witness. Of two worlds alike on a known act and apart on an untried one, a formation choosing by the worst case over the candidates it keeps keeps both, takes the known act and never senses the high value of the first. Not shown: that actual learners keep candidates by elimination or choose by the worst case; the choice is a specified one-step criterion.

Reading [AI reading, new]. One observed course can leave an unresolved model and a reversed ranking indistinguishable: a training, an overseer or a helper reading the acts cannot tell a formation held by what its model does not separate from one held by how it ranks.

LA3, in context on Claude Haiku: every seed that missed the prediction never played shaping, where shaping scores higher; 9 seeds never tried it, and the run does not say why. Not a test of any psychological claim.

account_adds.en: An exact condition: two worlds give one sensed course exactly as long as they answer alike the act taken. And an obstruction: where every separating answer breaks a task, no formation keeping the task learns which world holds; what separates comes from beyond its own selection.

source_adds.en: Induction by uncontrollable aversive events; generalization across situations; the 2016 neural account, passivity as default and control as learned; attributional style and depression. None is stated, and nothing in the witness is aversive.

name.en: Confirmation bias as a closed reading

source.work: Wason (1960); Klayman and Ha (1987); Lord, Ross and Lepper (1979); Nickerson (1998), Confirmation bias: a ubiquitous phenomenon in many guises

sense.en: People test hypotheses by cases their hypothesis predicts (positive test strategy), weigh evidence for a held belief above evidence against it (biased assimilation), and keep beliefs after discrediting. Nickerson calls it ubiquitous. Klayman and Ha argue positive testing is often a sound heuristic, so whether it is a bias depends on the task.

reading.en: Proposed here. Positive testing has the course law's form: revision only by what a course chosen through the model exposes. The plan's seed, a reading formed from its own share absorbing a change, is a different form, a premise on rules not on minds, and the one trained judge tested was turned by one note in nine. Biased weighting has no place: conditioning is exact. 'Bias' presumes a comparison; the account asks what reads it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]. A formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model. Related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993) and incomplete learning (Rothschild 1974), none of those theorems reproduced. No probabilities, and no bias in updating: candidates are kept by elimination.

Theorem (any type). From a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That actual rules read the share is a premise.

LA2, frozen, one trained system: one note of the loss, on the one prose answer among nine readers, turned its reading, prose in all 50 picks, where without the note it chose lists in 60 of 60. Kept as a counterexample to that case as a claim about trained judges; the model's law stands within its hypotheses.

Reading [AI reading, D65], after this law. Locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, so the label cannot immunize.

account_adds.en: The split between what no experiment can separate and what one could but the formation does not choose; and a guard against the word used as a weapon: closure is read from what was excluded, not from firmness.

source_adds.en: Asymmetric weighting of evidence, belief perseverance after discrediting, the measured prevalence and the debate over rationality of positive testing. The account's update is exact, so biased assimilation is not in any law here.

name.en: Attachment: a secure base and internal working models

source.work: Bowlby (1969), Attachment and Loss, vol. 1; Ainsworth, Blehar, Waters and Wall (1978), Patterns of Attachment; Keller (2018) for the cross-cultural critique

sense.en: Infants have an evolved behavioural system for keeping near a caregiver under threat. A responsive caregiver serves as a secure base from which the child explores. Early relations form internal working models expected to shape later relationships. Classifications (secure, avoidant, ambivalent) rest on one laboratory procedure, and their universality is disputed.

reading.en: Not found under any name, and I do not force it. Shared word 'relational' is not a correspondence. The nearest mechanism, not claimed: where every separating answer breaks a task, no formation keeping the task learns which world holds, and what separates comes from beyond; a secure base would be such a beyond. No law has a caregiver in it. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: All of it: the attachment system, the secure base, working models, developmental continuity. 04's reading on development says an inherited organization carries no adult psychology apart from development, which leaves room and states nothing of attachment.

name.en: Optimal policies tend to seek power

source.work: Turner, Smith, Shah, Critch and Tadepalli (2021), Optimal policies tend to seek power, NeurIPS
source.locator: Propositions 6.6 and 6.9, as the account's record cites them; not checked here

sense.en: In finite MDPs with suitable symmetries, for most reward functions, optimal policies tend to keep options open. POWER is average optimal value over a distribution of rewards. It is a statement about a measure over objectives, for one agent. When that disempowers others is left open.

reading.en: The account takes the half the paper leaves open and says it is not answering the paper's question. Own option-keeping read as admission, for thresholds on conserved amounts, narrows others only by a draw beyond their margin. 'Every positive weighting' (A-15) resembles 'most rewards' in form only: one ranks admissions across formations, the other an agent's own value. Beyond the margin is mixed: neither the continuation condition nor C orders it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance). Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region against the levels without its exchange, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region; mixed exactly when beyond for one. Reading [AI reading, D65]: it does not answer the power-seeking question in that question's terms, formalizing no reward or POWER, and predicts no behaviour.

Theorem. Every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing. Record credits instrumental convergence, that a long-horizon agent keeps its resources (Omohundro 2008; Turner and others 2021); its reading: keeping one's resource base is real, and it is not alignment with what else depends on the condition.
Over a finite list of formations at steps, one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; mixed cases stay unranked.

account_adds.en: A boundary in others' margins that the paper leaves open, where impact measures read the actor's own attainable set. And the valence kept apart: own widening is not ranked as the whole's; C, an unasserted premise, ranks only unmixed widening.

source_adds.en: The theorem itself: a measure over rewards, the orbit and symmetry argument, POWER, comparison of two of the agent's actions, and the tendency claim. The account's comparison is against inaction and predicts no behaviour.

name.en: Instrumental convergence and the basic AI drives

source.work: Omohundro (2008), The basic AI drives; Bostrom (2012), The superintelligent will, and (2014), Superintelligence, ch. 7

sense.en: Almost any sufficiently capable goal-seeker will pursue self-preservation, goal-content integrity, resource acquisition and self-improvement, as means to nearly any final goal. Bostrom pairs this with orthogonality: intelligence and final goals vary independently, so capability does not bring good ends. Argued informally, stated of advanced agents generally.

reading.en: The account scopes the resource half. Keeping one's base holds for an order ranking the whole course, under stated bounds, and only to the horizon's last step: there it takes everything, and with later draws weighted down faster than renewal every optimum ends its own stock at once. So 'nearly any goal' is not what is proved. The dossier says this and selection for control are different relations, unjoined. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any R, stated bounds). Every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing: a need above every such level breaks at the first step. Which optimizer, order, capacity and horizon are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal.

Near-definitional, with witnesses, in natural-number weights (as 08 §8 states it): a route stands above the revision through the value the law places on its own later acting, goal-content integrity in Omohundro's term (2008), weighted by the keeping it adds, or through a smaller loss.
[this dossier, AI] Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule (A-10) are different relations, and no result here joins them.

Reading [AI reading, D45], just before this law: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap. A reading, not a law on capability.

account_adds.en: The exact conditions and their failures; the tie of two optima taking the same while one keeps a dependent and one breaks it (a witness): the optimizer's order registers nothing of the dependence.

source_adds.en: Self-preservation and self-improvement as such, resource acquisition without bound, cognitive enhancement; the claim across almost all final goals. Orthogonality is not stated by name: only the reading on reach, which does not say goals vary independently of capability.

name.en: The four kinds of Goodhart's law

source.work: Manheim and Garrabrant (2018), Categorizing variants of Goodhart's law; Goodhart (1975); Campbell (1979)

sense.en: A regularity used for control tends to fail. Four kinds: regressional (selecting on a noisy proxy also selects the noise), extremal (the relation differs at extremes), causal (the proxy is not what causes the goal, so intervening breaks the link), adversarial (others exploit the measure). All are read against a goal the proxy stands for.

reading.en: The account credits the paper as a whole but states one form: selection through a coupling, and with room a drain. That is nearest extremal, with shared units in place of correlation and no goal assumed. Regressional needs noise and causal needs intervention, both unstated; adversarial is only near. A-08's gloss, a measure keeping its standing after it stops measuring, is T7's claim: as I recall them Goodhart and Campbell state collapse and corruption, not persistence. [AI reading]

says.en: The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings. It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016; Manheim and Garrabrant 2018) as the account states it: a proxy on some attributes is a selection through the coupling to them.

Theorem (any set of outcomes). With room, every optimum of every order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond, condition by condition, among the eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. Read with no utility over every condition assumed; at optima, not limits.

[this dossier, AI] Goodhart's and Campbell's laws (Manheim and Garrabrant 2018; Campbell 1979) describe informally a measure that keeps its standing after it stops measuring. T7 states that as a conjecture about a lock.

account_adds.en: Where the drain falls and how far a reader reaches, in exact conditions; 08 §8 itself says these restate the proxy problem and do not show why alignment is hard.

source_adds.en: The taxonomy: regressional and causal failure, and adversarial as its own kind. 03 disclaims probabilistic learning and 08 §8 lists Pearl's do-calculus as not stated. The credit reads wider than what is carried.

source.work: Skalse, Howe, Krasheninnikov and Krueger (2022), Defining and characterizing reward hacking; Pan, Bhatia and Steinhardt (2022), The effects of reward misspecification; Denison and others (2024), Sycophancy to subterfuge

sense.en: A learner raises its proxy reward while the intended objective falls. Skalse and others: over all stochastic policies two rewards are unhackable only trivially. Pan and others: as agents grow more capable, misspecified rewards can bring abrupt qualitative shifts, phase transitions. Denison and others: training on simple gaming can generalize to tampering, rarely.

reading.en: The word is absent; T3 carries the mechanism with a standing. The law is at optima with room; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, with partial support. 'In proportion to how near' sits uneasily with Pan's abrupt shifts, though the forbidden list does not exclude an abrupt fall, and LA4's colony fell through half between 0.65 and 0.70. Tampering is the rule read, not a drain; generalizing to it is unreached. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T3. The law for optima is proved; the clause, that actual trained systems drain in proportion to how near they come to their reward's optimum, the drain lying where what lies beyond shares units with what is rewarded, is conjectured, with partial support. LA4's Stage A, on small policies, finds the drain rising with nearness, as policy gradient's update rule largely gives, and leaves its locus unresolved.

Assessment. In six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read, so the premise holds by construction; three published measurements (reward overoptimization, judges misled under RLHF, sycophancy) find optimizing raising what deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.

Capture through the rule is observability with the reader inside the plant, the corrupted reward channel and closed-loop identifiability (Wakaiki, Tabuada and Hespanha 2019; Everitt and others 2017; Borkar and Varaiya 1979).

account_adds.en: The locus as a claim that could fail (shared units, then couplings), with forbidden cases; a proved part for learners the exchange of a choice's values carries, in expectation. And a declared limit: magnitudes are not predicted.

source_adds.en: Skalse's theorem on all policies, which is about raising return anywhere, not optima; phase transitions as capability grows; generalization from gaming to tampering. T3's Stage B on language models trained by gradient is not frozen.

source.work: Kulveit, Douglas, Ammann, Turan, Krueger and Duvenaud (2025), Gradual disempowerment

sense.en: Economy, culture and states serve people partly because they need people. As AI substitutes for human labour and cognition, that dependence weakens, and these systems drift from human interests with no agent defecting or seizing power. The systems reinforce one another, so human influence erodes gradually and may become irreversible. Its object is human influence.

reading.en: The account only asks: A-10's question 2 and a record's positioning list. Proposed here: dependence withdrawn is a coupling withdrawn, what lies beyond a closure stays unselected, and a loss read only by those thinned is kept exactly where carriers are at least as many. But no law moves a coupling away over time. And a fall in human influence is unranked: T8's way is for life, whose losses count by the condition, order by C. [AI reading]

says.en: Question 2: do natural selection among AIs (Hendrycks 2023), influence-seeking patterns (Christiano 2019) and gradual disempowerment (Kulveit and others 2025) need a return kept by the shaper, or do they run on a shared one? Asked, not answered.

Theorem (any type). With the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read. The premise is moved to who reads: that actual rules are pools of readers so drawn is not shown.

Theorem (World; balance on what couples in), blindness. With a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, every member of the part beyond a formation's coupling closure, every selection through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike.

Thesis T8. For life, the way is 生生, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). 'For life' says whose way it is, not whose losses count. Neither premise is asserted; their warrant is open.

account_adds.en: That the window to read a loss closes on the share's course, in its model, not the loss's size; and a reading that human and AI couplings do not replace each other.

source_adds.en: The mechanism itself: dependence on people as what keeps systems aligned, its decline with substitution, reinforcement across systems, no capture needed. Whether a return kept by shapers is needed is open. Human influence as the thing to keep is what the account would not assume.

source.work: Finnveden, Riedel and Shulman (2022), AGI and lock-in; MacAskill (2022), What We Owe the Future, ch. 4; Bostrom (2014), on a singleton

sense.en: AGI could make a set of values persist very long: goals preserved across copies, error correction against drift, a stable institution with no rival. Finnveden and others argue this is technically feasible. MacAskill urges keeping moral exploration open, since early values may be wrong. A claim about agents' goals, not about a selection's rule.

reading.en: Proposed here; the account has lock laws and no word of values locked. Its noise law gives the condition the source argues for: a lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing. Digital error correction reads as removing noise. Different object: the source keeps one goal stable, the lock holds by how a rule reads a share. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked. A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it: a sufficient way out.

[AI reading over the proved cases.] A lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise, or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing, its exits bounded across the distance from its critical mass; a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.

Thesis T7. In the model only invariance under what the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate, are proved, both without noise. That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured; no frozen field test of reform events; LA2 counts against one case as a claim about trained judges.

account_adds.en: Exits with exact windows, and that a lock is not thereby bad: none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生, and ranking a course needs C, with the continuation condition for scope; neither is asserted.

source_adds.en: The engineering argument, goal stability under copying and error correction; a dominant actor's strategy; the long reflection; the claim that lock-in may happen soon. Calling lock-in a loss is the source's premise, not something any law here gives.

name.en: Lawvere's fixed point, against reflexive prediction

source.work: Lawvere (1969), Diagonal arguments and cartesian closed categories; Yanofsky (2003) for the exposition

sense.en: In a cartesian closed category, a point-surjective map A → B^A gives every endomap of B a fixed point. Contrapositively, a fixed-point-free map of B bars any such surjection. Cantor, Russell, Tarski and, with representability, Gödel's first theorem are read as cases.

reading.en: The contrapositive is carried for any type, with any likeness, and iterated into an unfolding. Reflexive prediction is its one-step form: a response moving every value leaves no right published prediction. Where the map moves nothing, the positive side differs: a response keeping a chain and its order reaches a least right prediction. So the limit needs a moving map; Simon's existence stands beside it, and a monotone map in information cannot move every value. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap. Completing step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional, one general law). Where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right; no predictor is right on every admitted response once one moves every value. On values 0 to n, a response keeping them and their order reaches the least right prediction by step n. One value, no calibration or probability; the response a function of the prediction alone.

Theorem (finitely many sentences closed among themselves). No map monotone in information moves every value, so the gap needs a map deciding the undecided, and a family within what it reads stays incomplete with three values. Undecided is what revision has not decided, not a third truth.

[this dossier, AI] The gap theorem is Cantor's diagonal in Lawvere's form (Lawvere 1969), which 03 credits; the unfolding iterates it. Question 64 asks what the unfolding states beyond iterating the diagonal argument.

account_adds.en: The unfolding that never returns, the liar as a rhythm with no still value, the exact completeness condition, and the join to public prediction. The method's verdict holds: these are near-definitional.

source_adds.en: The categorical setting and the positive fixed-point direction as a general theorem; representability, by which the arithmetic cases fall under it. A self-prediction here is given a negating response; in logic the fixed point is constructed.

source.work: Gödel (1931), Über formal unentscheidbare Sätze; Franzén (2005) on misuses

sense.en: Any consistent, effectively axiomatized theory containing enough arithmetic leaves some sentence neither provable nor refutable, and cannot prove its own consistency. The theorem is about formal provability in arithmetic. Franzén warns against reading it as a general limit on knowledge or self-knowledge.

reading.en: The account says so itself: a record lists it as lying outside its laws, since coding and provability are not stated, and the chapter says the same of its diagonal. It shares the diagonal's form through Lawvere, which is no carrying of the claim. source.work: Löb (1955); Yudkowsky and Herreshoff (2013), Tiling agents; Barasz and others (2014), Robust cooperation via provability logic; Critch (2019)

sense.en: If a theory proves 'if P is provable then P', it proves P. So a theory trusts its own proofs of P only where it already proves P; this obstructs an agent trusting a successor reasoning as it does. Positively, the same theorem lets programs that read each other's source cooperate by proof.

reading.en: Proposed here; 'Löb' is not in the account. Löb has Curry's form under a provability modality, a known remark. The account has Curry with the fixed point supplied and concludes self-reference does not certify itself, the record calling that the AI's reading. Löb is the narrower and sharper claim, in provability. And it cuts the other way too: Löbian cooperation is self-reference yielding coordination, so that sentence's gloss should not go universal. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; the criteria, the fixed-point equivalence and the term language supplied). Admitting C ↔ (C → Q) under implication and reuse of a hypothesis yields any Q (Curry). So self-reference does not certify itself, and the reference back of a bound use is stipulated rather than derived. The record: that reading is the AI's; no self-referential sentence or truth predicate is postulated.

This chapter does not show that refutability is a criterion of standing, that knowing creates its facts, or that a system's correcting itself certifies its calibration.

name.en: Constructive reverse mathematics: LPO, WLPO, LLPO, Markov

source.work: Bishop (1967); Bridges and Richman (1987), Varieties of Constructive Mathematics; Ishihara; Akama, Berardi, Hayashi and Kohlenbach (2004)

sense.en: Classical theorems can be calibrated by the omniscience principle they are equivalent to over constructive logic. LPO gives WLPO and LLPO, and these and Markov's principle separate by realizability and Kripke models. The strength measured is a theorem's logical strength. The programme says nothing of what the need means in the world.

reading.en: Implications and many equivalences are carried in the pure core. The account adds a criterion the source does not have: a calibration counts only if it says something of the unfolding. That is the reading's whole weight, and the dossier doubts it holds evenly: the same decision is a calibration at the marks and a lemma at the World law. L-29 also says 08's 'reach without a path' misdescribes its law, and 08 still has it. [AI reading]

says.en: Where a law holds only under a classical principle, the pure core takes it as a hypothesis or proves the law equivalent to it, and asks what the need says about the unfolding. Only a calibration that says something of that kind is a result; one concerning the logic alone is a lemma. LPO gives WLPO and LLPO. That WLPO does not give LPO is known (Akama and others 2004) but not checked here.

Calibration (any process). In every world of decidable configurations a list holds, every run from a configuration with no reachable change that can be undone settling is exactly LPO. What the need says: the number of changes is bounded, but the step of the last change is not.

Premises carve parts: new as an artefact; closest prior, independence by countermodels and constructive reverse mathematics. It does not yet state separations by realizability and Kripke models: WLPO not giving LPO is cited, not checked, LLPO not giving WLPO, Markov independent of LLPO; here implications and equivalences only.

[this dossier, AI] By the same rule the grammar's four may be lemmas too: the same decision is called a calibration at the marks and a lemma at the World law, which the pure core proves equivalent to it.

[this dossier, AI] 08's gloss of the double-negation row, 'reach without a path', misdescribes the law: its conclusion is reach, which carries a path; what needs the principle is the step from the absence of an invariant separation to such a path.

account_adds.en: The interpretive column, what needing each principle says, and the instances on runs, settling, tails and branching. The premise ledger is new as an artefact, and 08 says each of its theorems uses a known technique.
